name: Danske Bank (UK)
policy: Asks security questions on its own calls.

questions.prompt: Does the caller do any of these?

options.text: Sends a link, or asks the person to open one
Asks for a one-time code, a PIN, or a password
Says they are the person's new account manager

questions.prompt: Does the caller ask the person security questions to confirm who they are?

options.text: Yes: security questions, such as date of birth, address, or the answers set up with the bank

rules.label: scam
rules.why: A link, a request for a code, or a "new account manager" is a scam sign at any bank.

rules.label: legit
rules.why: Danske Bank asks security questions on its calls, and this person asked for the change.

rules.label: unsure
rules.why: Danske Bank does call with security questions, but nothing shows this person asked for a change.
rules.advice: Hang up and call the number on the card.
